Name: Eunoia's Farmyard - Coop Animals (Chickens Dinos Ducks Eggs and Mayo)
Author: eunoiamods
Description:
[size=5][b]Eunoia's Farmyard - Coop Animals
[/b][/size]
Retextures and recolours most coop animals, their eggs and mayonnaise. Rabbits come separately.

All sprites come with a toggle and all animals come with and without blush! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20266]Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)[/url] is supported by default.

[b]Please[/b] let me know if you have any problems, or want to suggest new animals or features!

[i][b]Please[/b][b] don't[/b][/i] ask if I'm planning to make a version with a more muted colour palette or darker outlines. I like my shiny, bright style and I think some others do too! I appreciate you love the mod enough to want to use it in your game but there are many mods catering to that style, including some of the mods I've used to make this! Try checking them out instead.

[b][size=4]Future Plans
[/size][/b]
- Baby animal sprites.

- Other unsupported coop animals? (Let me know if there are any you want to see.)

[size=4][b]Troubleshooting[/b][/size]

When the mod is added to an existing save, the changes may fail to load properly. This can be fixed by changing the config to a different option and back again. Any other problems, let me know!
